✦ Investor Caution

Risk Disclosure Statement

Effective Date: October 27, 2026

Important Notice: Commercial aviation investments and fleet syndicates carry operational and market risks. Historical earnings, example flyer calculations, and community proofs do not constitute guaranteed returns. Never invest funds you cannot afford to risk.

1. Operational Aviation Risks

Revenue distribution is tied to commercial aviation schedules, route fuel margins, and aircraft maintenance cycles. While ASTRAVEN establishes reserves to maintain steady daily settlements, external factors such as aviation fuel price shocks or regulatory groundings can influence fleet performance.

2. Non-Guaranteed Past Performance

Community proofs and testimonials shared in the Community Blog represent individual user experiences and must not be interpreted as guaranteed earnings for all participants.

3. Capital Commitment & Maturity

SSVIP and Limited Route contracts commit your funds across the designated term. Early liquidation prior to maturity is not supported by contract rails. Ensure you evaluate your liquidity requirements before committing funds.

4. Review of System Rules

Prior to purchasing packages or submitting bank transfers, review our current deposit guidelines, withdrawal minimums, and fee structures in the FAQ and Terms.
